description: This is the main entry point for a Flutter-based Ludo mobile client app. It initializes the application by defining a root widget that sets up theming and loads the initial splash screen.

classes.name: LudoApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that sets up the MaterialApp with title, theme, and initial home screen (SplashScreen).

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the application that initializes and runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the LudoApp, returning a MaterialApp configured with theme and initial screen.
